name: expert-report-on-damages
description: Drafts and reviews expert reports on economic damages for U.S. litigation (lost profits, lost business value, reasonable royalty, unjust enrichment, personal economic loss) that the testifying expert can adopt and defend. Checks Rule 26(a)(2)(B) contents (opinions with basis and reasons, facts or data considered, exhibits, 10-year publications, 4-year testimony list, compensation) and Rule 26(b)(4) protections; tests opinions against FRE 702 as amended in 2023; tests management projections; aligns but-for and actual periods; applies incremental margin, avoided costs and mitigation; removes double counting across lost profits, business value, royalty and disgorgement; discounts future losses; keeps prejudgment interest a legal question. Use for damages expert report, lost profits analysis, Daubert damages opinion, rebuttal damages report, yardstick method. Declines to back-solve a target number. Routes personal injury wage loss to economic-loss-report and class damages to expert-report-class-damages.
